criteria_note: Scored A-F, G and guide criteria T1-T3. X1 (taxonomy) is for paper posts and was not scored. Claims were checked against the official Strands docs (agent-loop, hooks, interventions, human-in-the-loop, approve-before-acting, lifecycle-controls, structured-output(-behavior), retry-strategies, state, session-management, conversation-management, model-providers, python quickstart, observability), PyPI JSON, and strands-agents/harness-sdk main source (event_loop.py, sliding_window_conversation_manager.py). Third-party blog claims were not fetched and are marked unverifiable. No code was executed. Prose length counts characters excluding front matter, code blocks, tables, headings and Sources.

A.reason: Broken code fence: L169 '...A가 마지막에 닫게 되는 구조입니다. ```python' glues the fence to the sentence, so L171 '## excerpt: 감사 로그 훅 A와...' and L189 '## A, B 순으로 등록...' render as H2 headings and the fences after it pair up wrongly through L212. pip install appears twice (L50 and L368). One-sentence orphan paragraphs at L26 and L38. Front matter is fine.

B.reason: Mostly natural 합니다 prose. The lifecycle table (L245-249) leaves the '실행 시점' cells in English ('Before the agent loop starts'). Calques: L38 'Strands는 에이전트 루프를 직접 작성해야 할 자리에 쓰도록 설계됐습니다' -> 'Strands는 직접 짜던 에이전트 루프를 대신하도록 만들어졌습니다'; L654 'Deny 단락 평가 규칙'; L1093 '직접 메워야 하는 지점 두 곳을 보고합니다'.

C.reason: The ReAct subsection (L22-26) cuts in between the running example and the SDK description and ends in a stray one-sentence paragraph (L26). L1093 promises two gaps but the second ('GenAI 텔레메트리를 OTLP 스팬 이벤트로 기록') is not a gap. L1103 'harness' is never defined. Cross-references are otherwise accurate, and lookup_customer's late definition is flagged (L421).

D.reason: Good worked examples at the hard points: message counting (L79), hook-order A/B (L169), intervention pipeline walkthrough (L264), token overshoot arithmetic (L679). The ReAct background (L24) is a slight detour.

E.reason: Good tables (stop reasons L99, interventions L243/L253, cancel checkpoints L687, limits table L1123) and a text loop diagram (L60). The Datadog screenshot (L1087) is hotlinked from a vendor CDN and only decorates the text. English cells sit in a Korean table (L245-249).

F.reason: One wrong claim: L126/L133/L139 say window_size counts message pairs and that window_size=10 keeps about five tickets. The conversation-management doc and the source say window_size is the maximum number of messages (default 40), so 10 messages is about 2.5 tickets. The state doc says 'pairs', so the docs disagree with each other. Every other checked claim is supported, and third-party telemetry claims are attributed.

G.reason: The description is 120 chars, right at the minimum. The glued fence at L169 breaks rendering. Remote image at L1087. No math and no Liquid; fence info strings are fine.

T1.reason: Lots of real code. The hook-order example is unreadable because of the broken fence. ToolInterceptor uses self.safe_alternative_tool, which is never set (L229). handle_ticket (L791) puts an ask='stdio' HITL inside a server handler (the text admits at L814 that it cannot resume). Earlier examples use lookup_customer before its definition at L431 (marked as excerpts). No metrics.get_summary().

T2.reason: Covers loop, history, conversation manager, hooks, interventions, structured output, HITL/Cedar, limits/cancel/concurrency, retry, state/sessions and OpenTelemetry, all from the sources. The ReAct digression is minor padding.

T3.reason: Explains mechanisms and why they work that way (schema-as-tool, short-circuit, fail-open/closed, limit check timing, lock-free sessions), plus observability and a limits table. Stays at docs level with no source internals, and the harness comparison (L1101-1103) is thin.

A.reason: No broken fences, and the front matter is fine. Ordering problem: setup and the first agent ('## pip 한 줄에서...', L409) come after the hooks and interventions sections that already depend on agent.py (L141). The MCP docs-server subsection (L521-528) is off-topic padding. Orphan sentence at L99. The TL;DR (L14) is one very long paragraph.

B.reason: Natural 합니다/하십시오 register. Overlong sentences: L18 '모델에 계획을 맡기면 ... 얹어 둔 SDK입니다' (one 100+ char sentence; split it in two). Calque '단락' for short-circuit (L240 '이 구조에서 단락, 피드백 누적 ... 이 나옵니다', L249 '남은 핸들러를 단락'). L20 is a literal doc translation ('언어 모델은 질문에 답할 수 있지만, 에이전트는 일을 처리합니다').

C.reason: Forward references: L141 'agent.py에서 정의한 lookup_order, issue_refund를 그대로 씁니다' comes before agent.py is shown (L442), and L210 and L260 do the same. Unclear source references: L79 '위 글이 Python 소스를 분석한 결과', L83 '같은 글에 따르면' (the article is never named). L1075 '앞의 7월 비교 글' points to a July article the post never introduced. L1069 ends on a non sequitur about AgentResult. L99 refers to '이 결과', which nothing defines.

D.reason: Strong help at the hard parts: stack-depth table (L91-95), intervention pipeline trace table (L306-313) with a fix suggestion, attempt-counting walkthrough (L674), idempotency-token choice advice (L752). Easy parts are not padded, apart from the MCP server aside.

E.reason: Tables used well (risk-to-control L26, stop_reason branches L73, preset values L131, pipeline trace L306, attempt counting L652, failure modes L1081) plus a text diagram (L54). No images; one would not add much.

F.reason: No wrong or unsupported claim among 44 checked. Source-level claims match event_loop.py on main. One internal inconsistency: the failure-mode table L1085 says '핸들러에서 횟수를 세다가 Deny로 격상', but L321 notes Deny is invalid in after_model_call (the doc itself suggests escalating to Deny). Third-party claims (Lambda streaming, L1073) are attributed.

G.reason: Description 140 chars, opens with the product name. No math or Liquid; fences are clean; no remote images.

T1.reason: A runnable agent.py (L444-485) with an install/auth/run command (python -u agent.py), a provider swap and composable add-on blocks. But blocks are presented before agent.py exists, and triage_limited (L663), triage_stream (L686) and handle_ticket (L825) give the agent issue_refund without HITL, against the post's own advice at L594. No metrics.get_summary().

T2.reason: Broad, sourced coverage of loop internals, hooks, interventions, HITL/Cedar, setup and providers, structured output, lifecycle, retry, state and sessions. No observability section (OpenTelemetry appears only in the comparison, L1067-1069). Conversation-manager trimming is mentioned only in passing (L966). The MCP docs server (L521) is padding.

T3.reason: Goes past the docs into internals: recursive cycles and stack depth (L85-97), inner retry loop and BeforeModelCall cancel (L83), aux_model routing (L504-519), framework positioning and deployment limits (L1061-1089). Design advice is phrased as recommendations.
